title: Nonparametric Multi Change Point Detection for Markov Chains via Adaptive Clustering
summary: Offline change point detection tries to detect time points of distribution change in a given data sequence; and is now routinely used in signal processing, speech processing, climatology etc. Despite this broad applicability across economics, computer science, and planetary sciences, rigorous, nonparametric techniques for change point detection with non-independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) datasets has remained elusive.
